name: Agentified (sandboxed coding agents)
description: Installs Claude Code and/or Pi behind a default-deny egress boundary (CONNECT-allowlisting proxy + iptables backstop).

agents.description: Comma-separated agents to install: claude, pi, none.

profiles.description: Allowlist profiles to compose: base, claude, pi, editor, copilot, github-mcp, ruby, node, python, rust, go, playwright, svelte. Unknown names fail the build. Include the profile matching each agent you install.

allow.description: Extra allowed hosts, comma-separated. A leading dot means 'and all subdomains'.

extraCidrs.description: CIDRs reachable directly, bypassing the proxy (e.g. compose sidecars).

dnsMode.description: resolver-only: only the nameservers in /etc/resolv.conf are reachable. blocked: no direct DNS at all. open: any resolver.

mode.description: enforce: proxy allowlist + firewall. learn: firewall on, proxy logs but permits everything. off: neither.

proxyPort.description: Loopback port the allowlisting proxy listens on.

allowIpv6.description: Allow the proxy user to egress over IPv6. Everything else stays closed either way.

agentPolicy.description: Tell the agent the boundary is deliberate. strict: also deny it sudo and firewall commands via Claude Code managed settings. notes-only: advisory text only. off: neither. See docs/adr/0019.

installNodeIfMissing.description: Install a private Node runtime under /opt/agentified when Pi is requested and the image has none new enough. Claude Code is a native binary and needs no Node.
